blocks.text:
People’s party alters video of PM putting on Lamine Yamal’s Spain shirt in latest contentious use of AI in election race

Spanning 17 seconds, the campaign video showed the Spanish prime minister, Pedro Sánchez, speaking to the camera as he put on a jersey of the national football team. “Because this is what Spain is: a pluralistic and diverse country,” he said as he turned to reveal the number 19 on his back – the shirt number of the star player Lamine Yamal.

One day later, the opposition People’s party (PP) came under fire after it used AI to manipulate the same video, making it falsely appear as if Sánchez had donned a shirt belonging to the Moroccan national team.
